stations.title: Sefton
stations.text: Made two speed-ups of his own.

captions: At Ashgrove Press, Hesper wants the fast report every hour on the order server.
Sefton's own speed-ups lost a day of October and kept an old price.
You measure again, fix the slow step, and mend the two speed-ups.
Now October has every day, and each hour's report matches the first one exactly.
Same report, same answers, and you know when fast is fast enough.
